scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:local: ENV_FILE=backend/.env.local concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:preprod: npm run migrate:preprod && npm run build:preprod --prefix frontend
